slides.title: Ethiopia media restrictions: a timeline
slides.body: What CPJ has recorded since Oct 2025.

slides.title: Oct 2025: Deutsche Welle licences
slides.body: All nine correspondents suspended; seven have resumed work, CPJ says.

slides.title: Jan-Feb 2026: licence and accreditation
slides.body: Wazema Radio's licence revoked. Reuters accreditation revoked Feb 14; restored Aug 28, per Reuters.

slides.title: Nov 2026: The Reporter suspended
slides.body: CPJ reports the Media Authority suspended the newspaper indefinitely.

slides.title: Protect journalists, restore licences
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: CPJ · Feb 16 (updated Sep 15) and Nov 2026
